matchTitle.label: Match Title
matchTitle.description: Two notes must have the same title to be considered duplicates.

matchContent.label: Match Content
matchContent.description: Two notes must have the same content to be considered duplicates.

matchAttributes.label: Match Attributes
matchAttributes.description: Two notes must carry the same owned labels and relations to be considered duplicates.

normalizeContent.label: Ignore Formatting
normalizeContent.description: Compare content with HTML tags stripped and whitespace collapsed, so a reformatted copy still matches. Only applies when Match Content is on.

caseInsensitiveTitle.label: Ignore Title Case
caseInsensitiveTitle.description: Compare titles case-insensitively. Only applies when Match Title is on.

ignoreEmpty.label: Skip Empty Notes
ignoreEmpty.description: Skip notes whose content is empty. Recommended when Match Content is on, since every empty note would otherwise match every other empty note.

searchRoot.label: Scan Under
searchRoot.description: Limit the scan to this note's subtree. Leave blank to scan the whole tree.

excludeFilters.label: Exclude Filters
excludeFilters.description: Notes matching any enabled filter's search query are skipped by the scan.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Trilium search syntax (same as the search bar), e.g. #archived or note.type = code.
